Ultimea Sewer: Southeast

Nino
Pelulu
Romfh
Pasca
Felien
Balft
Unable to go beyond here yet!
What's wrong? You're tired with the repair?
Why are you so full of energy after repairing that\nnumber of walls...
Heh heh, you don't train like I do.\nBy the way, you'd better catch up everyone.\nLook...
Whoa!! Monsters everywhere...
What?
Noooooo!!
Ouch... Thanks...
Ouch... Thanks...\nHm? What are you doing?
Beautiful... What are they?!
Goddess Beads...
Goddess Beads... Ohhh! I've heard of it!!\nThey are the ores used for energy resource before\nthe cataclysm, right?!
Pino and Mubia the synthesist in Sofya said the\nsame thing...
They were mined excessively to supply energy to\nvarious engines and it may have caused the\ncataclysm. But they are said to be lost...
You know very much about it.\nYes, most of them are said to\nbe lost after the cataclysm but...
The vein remains here like a miracle.\nSo, we are using them as the energy supply for\nour hideout.
Hm? ...Of course, Lyark knows about here.
Sometimes they come to mine them, so be careful\nnot to bump into them, alright?
Hey, Pasca. We're always be careful but we've\nnever met them, have we? I wonder why.
They should need energy resource, so they could\ncome more frequently...
Come to think of it, maybe you're right...
Come to think of it, maybe you're right...\n! Maybe they are searching for another vein of\nGoddess Beads.
Well, seems like they are still having a hard time\nfinding energy resources though...
Okay, enough talk.\nEveryone hurry!
The key that Felien gave you seems like for\nthis door...
Here's one more interesting thing for you...
W-What is that...
It's like feeding the engine with the Goddess Beads.\n...It's nothing more than that though.
Feed? Is that engine or something living?!
Well, I don't know... Use the key and come in\nwhen you're prepared to be defeated by us.\nI'll be waiting for you there...
